title: Video Game Development
description:
I have a degree in Video Game Design and Production and I have experience developing projects of various genres in both 2D and 3D. I have created mechanics, characters, levels, animations, interfaces, effects and complete systems for action games, shooters, platformers and narrative experiences.

I have worked in design, art, programming and production roles. I am passionate about all areas of development and enjoy getting involved in each one to have a global vision of the project and understand in depth the whole creative and technical process.
